evidence: All five dimension prompts plus the shared tests/app_context.md describe HireOps only. (1) Product/URL/deliverable: app_context.md:3-4 'Name: HireOps', 'URL: http://localhost:3000' matches instruction.md:13 port 3000 and solution index.js:22. test.sh:198-200 substitutes {app_context} into every prompt, so all five dimensions get the same HireOps context. (2) Credentials: app_context.md:8-19 list password `Hireops!2026` and the ten accounts with roles. These exactly match instruction.md:17 and seed users (USR-REC1..3 Rafael Costa/Mei Lin/Farah Nasser recruiter; USR-MGR1..3 Ingrid Sorensen/Bill Okafor/Yuki Tanaka hiring_manager; USR-OBS1 Aud Halvorsen observer; USR-CAN1..3 Noor Haddad/Tomas Varga/Lena Fischer candidate). (3) Screens: app_context.md:23-25 Board per job with stages Applied..Rejected, Conversations and Activity, plus candidate applications. This matches instruction.md:11 and hireops_rules.md:42-43 and section 7. Visual prompt.md:14 reviews the same surfaces (Board, card details, Conversations, Activity, candidate view). The render criterion (gates/render/judge.toml:23) cites 'a job board, conversations or activity'. (4) Entities and seed facts cited in prompts were re-derived from seed_data.json. Three jobs: Platform Engineer/Ingrid, Data Analyst/Bill, Product Designer/Yuki. Noor's Platform Engineer conversation APP-101 has 120 messages, matching app_context.md:29-30. Lena's Product Designer APP-301 has 3 messages and read_count 2, the 3rd from Farah, so 1 unread, matching functional prompt Z (line 25) and hro_unread_counts. Tomas's seeded Data Analyst APP-201 is the fallback in protocol T. Candidate wording in hro_candidate_view matches seed candidate_status_labels and hireops_rules.md section 7. Page size 30 in hro_thread_latest/earlier matches seed thread_page_size and rules section 6. (5) Protocol arithmetic: I traced S/M/L/B. A+D in a 2-place Interview, then D leaves for Hired before B enters. The E undo is blocked by Mei's A return (2 of 2). Y up two gives Y,W,X,Z,A2. Board order on bulk arrival is Y,W,X, then A2,V. Mei's U count is Bill + Tomas's three. Each expected outcome agrees with hireops_rules.md section 3. (6) Tool names: the functional prompt line 1 says 'restart_app', which matches restart_mcp.py:14. functional/judge.toml:14-18 wires the verifier server with $APP_RESTART_HELPER (test.sh:193). (7) No residue: a case-insensitive grep over tests/**/*.md and judge.toml for every sibling project name under projects/ found nothing outside HireOps. The terms covered bazaar, boardloom, brickfall, ballot, coursemark, docket, drawbill, dropline, expense, gambit, gridforge, medcare/medicare/medledger, orbital, oriel/permit, patchpad, pellmoor, ridgeline, threadline, torquebay, utilibill, pixeldeck, snake and colderwater. The grep also covered foreign-domain nouns (SKU, cart, checkout, invoice, patient, ticket, listing, claim) and template residue (CHANGE_ME, TODO, FIXME, lorem). I extracted every capitalised proper-noun phrase from the prompts and criteria. Every one is a HireOps person, job, stage, view or generic word. The template's 'CHANGE_ME' app_context (rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/app_context.md:3,8,12) is fully replaced. Minor observation (P3, not a defect): functional prompt protocol A (line 49) asks for activity lines of actions 'in S, M, L, C, B and R'. Criterion hro_activity (functional/judge.toml:263) says 'every successful action you performed on J1 and J2'. That wording also takes in T/K actions on J2, such as adding Tomas's card and K's two moves, reject and reopen. Both readings require only real activity lines that hireops_rules.md section 4 mandates. A conforming app passes either reading. The narrower prompt list could only let an app that omits K/T lines escape, and the criterion text is the stricter controlling bar. I record this as an internal-scope wording mismatch, not residue or an inaccurate description of the app. Run evidence: none needed for this static row; no judge transcript was consulted.
suggested_fix: Optional tidy-up: align functional protocol A's list ('S, M, L, C, B and R') with hro_activity's 'every successful action on J1 and J2'. Either add T and K to the list or restrict the criterion to the same protocols.
